influence.en: Monday tape: Nasdaq 25164.32, S&P 500 7541.40, Dow 51983.98, WTI 96.46, Brent 104.77, COMEX gold 3957.67, 10-year yield 4.9125%, Shanghai 3638.03, and ISM manufacturing 55.5 versus a 54.7 survey.
3 November 财经早茶. Iran talks, a Nasdaq 100 correction, Apple's China miss, a standing China equity-support tool, and an empty-body government bond financing chart.
influence.zh: 11月3日财经早茶。伊朗谈判、纳斯达克100进入技术性回调、苹果中国收入不及预估、资本市场支持工具改为长期安排，以及正文为空的政府债融资图。

keySources.label: 第一财经 回购增持再贷款

influence.en: Yicai (2 November). The buyback relending rate was cut from 1.25% to 1% and the tool was made permanent. Signed loans are about 4400 hundred million yuan (CNY440bn).
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月2日）。回购增持再贷款利率由 1.25% 降至 1%，并改为长期制度。签约金额约 4400 亿元（CNY440bn）。

keySources.label: 中国经济网 隔夜逆回购

influence.en: China Securities Journal via ce.cn (3 November). Monday's first overnight reverse repo was 5410 hundred million yuan (CNY541bn) at 1.25%, and the net drain was 5150 hundred million yuan (CNY515bn).
influence.zh: 中国证券报经中国经济网（11月3日）。周一首次隔夜逆回购 5410 亿元（CNY541bn），利率 1.25%，净回笼 5150 亿元（CNY515bn）。

influence.en: BlockBeats (3 November). After a 6.3 billion dollar theft, Binance bitcoin depth within 1% of the price fell about 30%, from 45 million dollars to 32 million dollars.
influence.zh: 律动（11月3日）。6.3 billion dollars（63 亿美元）被盗后，币安比特币在价格 1% 以内的深度下降约 30%，从 45 million dollars 降至 32 million dollars。

influence.en: BlockBeats (3 November). Vance said US-Iran talks had made some progress and that no deadline is set for resuming strikes.
influence.zh: 律动（11月3日）。万斯称美伊谈判已有一些进展，恢复打击没有设定期限。

influence.en: BlockBeats (2 November), relaying Glassnode. Sellers have been capitulating below 80000 dollars.
influence.zh: 律动（11月2日）转述 Glassnode。卖盘在 80000 美元下方持续投降。

influence.en: BlockBeats (2 November). Fitch put Oracle's financing at 20 billion dollars, including 10 billion dollars of equity.
influence.zh: 律动（11月2日）。惠誉称甲骨文融资规模为 20 billion dollars，其中股权融资 10 billion dollars。

keySources.label: CICC 11月2日 市场如何见底

influence.en: CICC (2 November). Hong Kong feels the household credit cycle before A-shares do, and an early Hong Kong low has been a hedge bid.
influence.zh: 中金（11月2日）。港股比 A 股更早反映居民信用周期，港股更早的低点来自避险买盘。

title.en: Nov-Dec net government-bond financing is drawn second only to the 2024 bar
title.zh: 11月至12月政府债净融资被画成仅次于2024年那根柱

analysis.en: Orange bars are November-to-December net government-bond financing for 2016 through 2025. The 2026 bar is black and sits a little above the 20000 line, about 21000. The 2024 bar is the tallest and nears the 30000 line. A footnote says the 2026 bar is an institute estimate and earlier bars use bond-market sums. These reads are about, from the image.
analysis.zh: 橙色柱是2016年至2025年11月至12月政府债净融资。2026年黑色柱略高于20000刻度，约21000。2024年柱最高，接近30000刻度。图注写明2026年为研究机构测算，往年用债券市场数据加总。这些读数来自图像，是约数。

marketTone.en: Monday took the Iran premium out of oil. WTI fell 7.36% to 96.46 and Brent fell 7.63% to 104.77, while the Nasdaq fell 1.07% to 25164.32 and the Dow rose. China cut the buyback relending rate from 1.25% to 1%, and Shanghai rose 1.08% to 3638.03. The chart draws 2026 Nov-Dec government-bond net financing at about 21000, second only to 2024.
marketTone.zh: 周一的谈判把伊朗溢价从油价里拿掉了。WTI 下跌 7.36% 至 96.46，布伦特下跌 7.63% 至 104.77，纳斯达克下跌 1.07% 至 25164.32，道琼斯上涨。中国把回购增持再贷款利率从 1.25% 降至 1%，上证上涨 1.08% 至 3638.03。图表把 2026 年 11 月至 12 月政府债净融资画在约 21000，仅次于 2024 年。

text.en: On Monday the Dow rose 0.41% to 51983.98, the S&P 500 fell 0.51% to 7541.40, and the Nasdaq fell 1.07% to 25164.32. The Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 3.35%. 华尔街见闻 printed those closes.

December WTI fell 7.36% to 96.46 and January Brent fell 7.63% to 104.77. COMEX December gold rose 1.51% to 3957.67. The 10-year yield was 4.9125% and the 2-year yield was 4.5895%. 华尔街见闻 printed those levels.

On Monday Shanghai rose 1.08% to 3638.03 and ChiNext rose 1.87% to 2458.70. The Hang Seng rose 0.42% to 23393.32 and Hang Seng Tech rose 2.25% to 3839.41. The buyback relending rate was cut from 1.25% to 1%, and third-batch swap applications exceeded 1000 hundred million yuan (CNY100bn). 华尔街见闻 printed the closes and the tool.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：周一首上证上涨 1.08% 至 3638.03，创业板上涨 1.87% 至 2458.70。恒生指数上涨 0.42% 至 23393.32，恒生科技上涨 2.25% 至 3839.41。回购增持再贷款利率由 1.25% 降至 1%，第三批互换便利申报超过 1000 亿元（CNY100bn）。

text.en: The ISM manufacturing index rose to 55.5, above the 54.7 survey, and the prices index eased to 75.2 from 77.9. 华尔街见闻 printed the release.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：ISM 制造业指数升至 55.5，高于预期 54.7，价格指数从 77.9 降至 75.2。

signal.en: Talks took the strike premium out of crude, with Brent at 104.77, and the same oil drop bid gold to 3957.67 and the 10-year yield to 4.9125%. The Nasdaq still fell 1.07% to 25164.32 because AI spending is being financed with new capital. China cut the buyback relending rate from 1.25% to 1% and Shanghai rose 1.08% to 3638.03. The chart puts 2026 late-year government-bond supply at about 21000, second only to 2024.
signal.zh: 谈判拿掉了原油里的打击溢价，布伦特收在 104.77；同一轮油价下跌把黄金买到 3957.67，10年期收益率收到 4.9125%。纳斯达克仍下跌 1.07% 至 25164.32，因为 AI 开支还在靠新融资支付。中国把回购增持再贷款利率从 1.25% 降至 1%，上证上涨 1.08% 至 3638.03。图表把 2026 年年底政府债供给画在约 21000，仅次于 2024 年。

watch.en: The RBA decides at 11:30 Beijing time, 财经早茶 survey 4.85% after 4.6%. Hong Kong third-quarter GDP is at 16:30, survey 3.7% after 4.3%, and September retail sales at the same time, survey 4.7% after 5.6%. US September job openings are at 23:00, survey 716.2 after 707.9, in units of ten thousand. Factory orders at 23:00 are survey 1.2% after 0.1%. US midterms are today. The Bank of England decides 5 November. US October payrolls are 6 November. China October reserves are 7 November.
watch.zh: 澳洲联储 11:30 决议，财经早茶预估 4.85%，前值 4.6%。香港第三季度 GDP 在 16:30，预估 3.7%，前值 4.3%；同日零售销售预估 4.7%，前值 5.6%。美国 9 月职位空缺在 23:00，预估 716.2，前值 707.9，单位为万人。工厂订单同在 23:00，预估 1.2%，前值 0.1%。美国中期选举在今天。英国央行 11月5日决议。美国 10 月非农在 11月6日。中国 10 月外汇储备在 11月7日。

note.en: From the 3 November 财经早茶, in mail order. Closes live in Market closes and the sourced summary.
note.zh: 取自 11月3日财经早茶的市场一览，顺序与邮件一致。收盘价见市场收盘和有来源的摘要。

text.en: The Nasdaq 100 entered a technical correction. Chip stocks kept falling, and megacap results deepened the worry about AI.
text.zh: 纳斯达克100指数跌入技术性回调区间，芯片股继续重挫，科技巨头财报加剧AI之忧

text.en: The Golden Dragon China index rebounded and logged its largest gain in more than three weeks. Alibaba and Yum China contributed the most.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数反弹，创下三周多以来的最大涨幅，阿里巴巴和百胜中国对指数贡献最大

text.en: Treasuries extended their gains. The sharp drop in oil eased the inflation worry.
text.zh: 国债维持涨势，油价重挫缓解通胀担忧

text.en: The Bloomberg dollar index fell with oil. Investors turned their attention to Tuesday's US midterm elections.
text.zh: 彭博美元指数随油价走低，投资者将注意力转向周二的美国中期选举

text.en: As cheaper oil weakened hike expectations, UK government bonds logged their largest gain since early September, and European equities closed higher.
text.zh: 随着油价下跌削弱加息预期，英国国债创9月初以来最大涨幅，欧洲股市收涨

text.en: Crude futures logged their largest drop in three months. Both the United States and Iran said they are open to talks.
text.zh: 原油期货创三个月最大跌幅，美伊均表示对谈判持开放态度

text.en: Copper rebounded from a one-week low, with signs of constrained mine supply supporting the price. Gold rose as lower energy prices eased the inflation worry.
text.zh: 铜价从一周低点反弹，矿山供应受限迹象为价格提供支撑。金价上涨，能源价格回落缓解通胀担忧

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

title.en: Talks pulled the Iran supply premium out of crude
title.zh: 谈判把伊朗供应溢价从原油里拿掉了

fact.en: December WTI fell 7.36% to 96.46 dollars a barrel and January Brent fell 7.63% to 104.77, 华尔街见闻 reported. BlockBeats reported that Vice President Vance said the talks had made some progress and that no deadline is set for resuming strikes.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月 WTI 下跌 7.36% 至 96.46 美元，1月布伦特下跌 7.63% 至 104.77。律动：副总统万斯称谈判已有一些进展，恢复打击没有设定期限。

mechanism.en: A drop of this size means crude had been carrying a strike premium, and the talk of a deal took that premium out. 财经早茶 (3 November): Tehran and Washington both said they are open to a deal, and crude futures logged their largest drop in three months. Oil carries the 7.36% WTI fall to 96.46 and the 7.63% Brent fall to 104.77. The theme changes if talks stall and Brent climbs back through 104.77.
mechanism.zh: 这样大的跌幅说明原油此前带着打击溢价，谈成协议的消息把溢价拿掉了。财经早茶（11月3日）：德黑兰和华盛顿都表示对协议持开放态度，原油期货创下三个月最大跌幅。原油对应 WTI 7.36% 的下跌至 96.46，以及布伦特 7.63% 的下跌至 104.77。若谈判停滞且布伦特重新站上 104.77，这一判断不再成立。

title.en: New AI funding is still being marked down in cash trading
title.zh: 新的 AI 融资仍在常规交易里被减价

fact.en: The Nasdaq fell 1.07% to 25164.32 and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 3.35%, 华尔街见闻 reported. Meta is preparing a bond sale of at least 200 hundred million dollars, and BlockBeats said Fitch put Oracle's financing at 20 billion dollars, including 10 billion dollars of equity.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：纳斯达克下跌 1.07% 至 25164.32，费城半导体指数下跌 3.35%。Meta 准备发行至少 200 亿美元的债券。律动：惠誉称甲骨文融资为 20 billion dollars，其中包括 10 billion dollars 股权融资。

mechanism.en: New bonds are still being sold to pay for AI spending, and the cash session marked down the shares tied to that bill. GS (2 November): the growth rate of AI capital spending is close to a peak. US equities carry the 1.07% Nasdaq fall to 25164.32 and the 3.35% semiconductor-index fall. The theme changes if those firms fund the next round from cash flow and the semiconductor index stops falling.
mechanism.zh: 新债仍在出售，用来支付 AI 开支，常规交易把绑在这张账单上的股票减了价。高盛（11月2日）：AI 资本开支增速的峰值已经很近。美股对应纳斯达克 1.07% 的下跌至 25164.32，以及半导体指数 3.35% 的下跌。若这些公司改用自身现金流支付下一轮开支且半导体指数停止下跌，这一判断不再成立。

title.en: Gold bounced as the energy-inflation scare eased
title.zh: 能源带来的通胀担忧缓和，黄金反弹

fact.en: COMEX December gold rose 1.51% to 3957.67 dollars an ounce, 华尔街见闻 reported. 财经早茶 said gold rose as energy prices fell and the inflation worry eased.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 12月黄金上涨 1.51% 至 3957.67 美元。财经早茶称能源价格回落、通胀担忧缓和，金价上涨。

mechanism.en: The bounce arrived with the oil drop, so the metal was trading the energy-inflation scare. GS (2 November): sovereign and unreportable accounts have led the futures selling. Gold carries the 1.51% rise to 3957.67. The theme changes if futures give back this bounce.
mechanism.zh: 反弹与油价下跌同一天出现，说明黄金在交易能源带来的通胀担忧。高盛（11月2日）：期货抛售的主力是主权账户和不可报告账户。黄金对应 1.51% 的上涨至 3957.67。若期货回吐这次反弹，这一判断不再成立。

title.en: A hot factory survey left the bond rally intact
title.zh: 工厂调查偏热，债市涨势还在

fact.en: The ISM manufacturing index rose to 55.5, above the 54.7 survey, while the prices index eased to 75.2 from 77.9, 华尔街见闻 reported. The same tape put the 10-year yield at 4.9125% and the 2-year yield at 4.5895%.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：ISM 制造业指数升至 55.5，高于预期 54.7，价格指数从 77.9 降至 75.2。同一条行情里，10年期收益率报 4.9125%，2年期收益率报 4.5895%。

mechanism.en: A hotter factory survey left the bond rally intact, which fits cheaper energy more than a weaker economy. GS (2 November): profit growth is still strong, but it is no longer speeding up. Treasuries carry the 55.5 index against a 54.7 survey and the 4.9125% ten-year yield. The theme changes if the next activity print misses its survey and the ten-year yield rises.
mechanism.zh: 更热的工厂调查没有打断债市上涨，这更像能源变便宜，而不是经济变弱。高盛（11月2日）：盈利增长仍然强，但已经不再加快。美债对应 55.5 的指数相对 54.7 的预期，以及 4.9125% 的 10 年期收益率。若下一次活动数据不及预期且 10 年期收益率回升，这一判断不再成立。

title.en: The buyback loan is now a standing, cheaper tool
title.zh: 回购增持贷款变成了更便宜的长期工具

fact.en: Shanghai rose 1.08% to 3638.03 and ChiNext rose 1.87% to 2458.70, 华尔街见闻 reported. The buyback relending rate was cut from 1.25% to 1%, and applications for the third swap facility exceeded 1000 hundred million yuan (CNY100bn), with the existing balance at 1050 hundred million yuan (CNY105bn).
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证上涨 1.08% 至 3638.03，创业板上涨 1.87% 至 2458.70。回购增持再贷款利率由 1.25% 降至 1%，第三批互换便利申报超过 1000 亿元（CNY100bn），存量余额 1050 亿元（CNY105bn）。

factSources.label: 第一财经 回购增持再贷款

mechanism.en: A standing buyback loan at a lower rate is a larger support bid than a one-day meeting. CICC (2 November): Hong Kong feels the household credit cycle before A-shares do, and an early Hong Kong low has been a hedge bid. A-shares carry the 1.08% Shanghai rise to 3638.03 and the 1.87% ChiNext rise to 2458.70. The theme changes if the lower loan rate draws no real buybacks and the indices give back the rise.
mechanism.zh: 更低利率的长期回购贷款，比一场一天的会议是更大的支撑买盘。中金（11月2日）：港股比 A 股更早感受到居民信用周期，港股更早的低点来自避险买盘。A 股对应上证 1.08% 的上涨至 3638.03，以及创业板 1.87% 的上涨至 2458.70。若更低的贷款利率带不来真实回购且指数回吐涨幅，这一判断不再成立。

title.en: The exchange is paying up to refill a thinner book
title.zh: 交易所在加价，想把变薄的订单簿补上

fact.en: BlockBeats reported a theft of 6.3 billion dollars and a drop of about 30% in Binance bitcoin depth within 1% of the price, from 45 million dollars to 32 million dollars. The same desk carried a Glassnode note that sellers were capitulating below 80000 dollars.
fact.zh: 律动：被盗 6.3 billion dollars（63 亿美元），币安比特币在价格 1% 以内的深度下降约 30%，从 45 million dollars 降至 32 million dollars。同一家通讯社转述 Glassnode：卖盘在 80000 美元下方投降。

mechanism.en: The firm is paying up for quotes because the book got thinner after the theft. Glassnode (2 November): sellers have been capitulating below 80000 dollars. Bitcoin carries the 6.3 billion dollar theft and the thinner book. The theme changes if that depth is rebuilt and withdrawals slow without another large theft.
mechanism.zh: 公司在为报价加价，因为被盗之后订单簿变薄了。Glassnode（11月2日）：卖盘在 80000 美元下方持续投降。比特币对应 6.3 billion dollars 的被盗，以及变薄的订单簿。若深度修复且提款放缓、又没有另一笔大额被盗，这一判断不再成立。

globalRegime.en: Monday's session took a strike premium out of oil, kept selling shares tied to AI funding, and bid bonds and gold as energy got cheaper. China turned a market-support loan into a standing, cheaper facility. The chart draws late-year government-bond financing as still heavy.
globalRegime.zh: 周一的交易拿掉了原油里的打击溢价，继续抛售与 AI 融资绑在一起的股票，并在能源变便宜时买入债券和黄金。中国把一笔稳市贷款变成了更便宜的长期工具。图表显示年底政府债融资仍然很重。

text.en: Iran's supreme leader authorized the government to pursue peace talks. Trump said a deal with Tehran is possible and denied that strikes would resume after the midterms, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：伊朗最高领袖授权政府推进和平谈判。特朗普称有可能与德黑兰达成协议，并否认中期选举后将恢复打击。

text.en: The ISM said October manufacturing expanded faster than expected, and the production gauge was the strongest since 2021. 华尔街见闻 put the index at 55.5 versus a 54.7 survey, with the prices index at 75.2 after 77.9.
text.zh: 财经早茶：供应管理学会称 10 月制造业扩张快于预期，生产指标创 2021 年以来新高。华尔街见闻：指数为 55.5，预期 54.7，价格指数从 77.9 降至 75.2。

text.en: The Nasdaq 100 entered a technical correction from its early-October high, the Philadelphia semiconductor index extended a three-day drop, and Asian tech shares are expected to feel it, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：隔夜纳斯达克100指数从 10 月初高点进入技术性回调，费城半导体指数的三日跌幅扩大，亚洲科技股料承压。

text.en: Apple's revenue growth slowed, China revenue missed estimates, and a holiday-quarter outlook above the street still failed to hold the shares, which fell after the call, 财经早茶 reported. 华尔街见闻 put revenue at 1144.8 hundred million dollars and iPhone sales at 575.8 hundred million dollars, against surveys of 1134.7 and 564.9, and a holiday growth outlook of 7% to 10% against a 6.1% survey.
text.zh: 财经早茶：苹果上季度营收增长放缓，中国市场收入不及预估，高于华尔街预期的假日季展望也未能留住股价，电话会后下跌。华尔街见闻：营收 1144.8 亿美元，iPhone 销售 575.8 亿美元，预期分别为 1134.7 和 564.9；假日季增长展望 7% 至 10%，预期 6.1%。

text.en: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue was 169.56 hundred million dollars, up 1127% from a year earlier, with a net loss of 232.91 hundred million dollars and compute commitments of about 8954 hundred million dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：Anthropic 第三季度营收 169.56 亿美元，同比增长 1127%，净亏损 232.91 亿美元，算力承诺约 8954 亿美元。

text.en: Trump's chief economic adviser Hassett pushed back on the AI financing worry and said the industry does not face a wholesale selloff, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普首席经济顾问哈塞特反驳 AI 融资担忧，称该行业不存在被全面抛售的风险。

text.en: Meta is considering a dollar and euro bond sale of at least 200 hundred million dollars, and Alphabet is raising about 60 hundred million euros, 华尔街见闻 reported. BlockBeats said Oracle's financing is 20 billion dollars, including 10 billion dollars of equity.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：Meta 考虑发行至少 200 亿美元的美元和欧元债券，Alphabet 筹资约 60 亿欧元。律动：甲骨文融资 20 billion dollars，其中包括 10 billion dollars 股权。

text.en: Marvell agreed to buy the optical-component maker Lumentum in stock for about 1150 hundred million dollars, which would be among the largest technology deals on record, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶与华尔街见闻：美满电子科技拟以股票收购光通信器件制造商 Lumentum，金额约 1150 亿美元，将成为科技行业史上最大并购交易之一。

text.en: The Bank of France governor said markets may be overreacting to France's fiscal challenge and that the budget is likely to pass parliament, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：法国央行行长称，市场可能对法国面临的财政挑战反应过度，预算案在议会通过的可能性很大。

text.en: Goldman Sachs said US corporate profit growth is no longer accelerating and that the growth in AI investment spending is also near a peak. Large multi-strategy hedge funds are highly levered, and similar equity books could amplify a shock, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：高盛表示美国企业获利增速不再加快，AI 投资支出的增长也在见顶。大型多策略对冲基金杠杆高企，股票持仓趋同可能放大市场冲击。

text.en: Since last week's record theft, funds have kept leaving Binance, and the firm says the pace is still inside the range it expected, 财经早茶 reported. BlockBeats reported a thinner order book and higher rebates for some market makers.
text.zh: 财经早茶：自上周创纪录的被盗以来，资金持续流出币安，公司称提款规模仍在预期范围内。律动：订单簿变薄，部分做市商返佣提高。

text.en: Trump said that if Democrats control Congress after the midterms, he is willing to offer protective pardons to Musk and close aides, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普表示，如果民主党在中期选举后控制国会，他愿意向马斯克及亲近助手提供保护性赦免。

text.en: Goldman Sachs has reportedly barred most staff from using Claude Code and GitHub's coding assistant, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：高盛据悉禁止大多数员工使用专为编程设计的 Claude Code 和 GitHub 工具。

text.en: If the talks stall, the strike premium can return to crude and to hike expectations in Europe.
text.zh: 若谈判停滞，打击溢价可以回到原油，也可以回到欧洲的加息预期。

text.en: If megacaps keep paying for AI spending with new bonds, semiconductor shares can keep falling even when the Dow rises.
text.zh: 若超大市值公司继续用新债支付 AI 开支，半导体股票可以在道琼斯上涨时继续下跌。

text.en: If factory surveys stay hot while long yields fall, the Treasury bid is the cheaper-oil move.
text.zh: 若工厂调查维持偏热而长端收益率下降，国债买盘就是油价变便宜这一笔。

globalTensions.en: US tech and energy fell while the Dow and European equities rose. Gold rose on the day oil fell. A-shares rose while US chip shares fell. The chart shows a heavy 2026 government-bond financing bar, second only to 2024, beside tools that are meant to support equities.
globalTensions.zh: 美国科技股和能源股下跌，道琼斯和欧洲股市上涨。油价下跌的同一天黄金上涨。A 股上涨，美国芯片股下跌。图表显示 2026 年政府债融资柱很重，仅次于 2024 年，旁边却是用来支撑股市的工具。

chinaStance.en: The overnight reverse repo is now the policy rate. Monday's first tender was 5410 hundred million yuan (CNY541bn) at 1.25%, with a net drain of 5150 hundred million yuan (CNY515bn), after 560 hundred million yuan of 7-day repos and 1 trillion yuan of overnight repos matured. The same day the buyback relending rate was cut from 1.25% to 1% and made permanent. 第一财经 and 华尔街见闻 carried the equity tools. The chart shows late-year government-bond supply still heavy.
chinaStance.zh: 隔夜逆回购现在是政策利率。周一首次招标为 5410 亿元（CNY541bn），利率 1.25%，净回笼 5150 亿元（CNY515bn）；当天到期的是 560 亿元 7 天期逆回购和 1 万亿元隔夜逆回购。同一天，回购增持再贷款利率由 1.25% 降至 1%，并改为长期工具。第一财经和华尔街见闻报道了股市工具。图表显示年底政府债供给仍然很重。

text.en: China widened capital-market support. The central bank said it will run the securities, fund, and insurer swap facility when needed, and the buyback relending tool moves from a temporary plan to a standing one, with the rate cut from 1.25% to 1%, 财经早茶 reported. 华尔街见闻 put the existing swap balance at 1050 hundred million yuan (CNY105bn) and third-batch applications above 1000 hundred million yuan (CNY100bn).
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国加大资本市场支持力度，央行表示将适时开展证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作；股票回购增持再贷款由阶段性安排转为长期制度，利率由 1.25% 降至 1%。华尔街见闻：互换便利余额 1050 亿元（CNY105bn），第三批申报超过 1000 亿元（CNY100bn）。

sources.label: 第一财经 回购增持再贷款

text.en: The CSRC said it will guide brokers on margin financing ratios, adjust rules for support-style buybacks, and raise the coverage of the dedicated relending tool, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：证监会承诺指导券商研究优化融资保证金比例，拟对上市公司护盘式回购调整优化，提高股票回购增持专项再贷款覆盖率。

text.en: China plans to ease current-account foreign-exchange rules and to roll out trade FX facilitation nationwide from next year, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国拟优化经常项目外汇管理，明年起全国推广贸易外汇便利化措施。

text.en: China plans to amend the tax administration law and to allow compulsory measures against individuals with very large tax arrears, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国拟修改税收征收管理法，对欠税额巨大的个人实施强制措施。

text.en: Vice Premier He Lifeng, visiting energy and technology firms in Shanxi, called for a shift in the coal industry and faster buildout of computing-power networks, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国副总理何立峰到山西调研能源、科技等企业，提出要推动煤炭产业转型，加快算电协同和算力网建设。

text.en: DeepSeek launched a creator mode for building custom plugins quickly, aimed at stronger AI agents, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：DeepSeek 推出可以快速创建自定义插件的创作者模式，旨在强化 AI 智能体能力。

text.en: HKEX began accepting eligible renminbi fixed-income assets as margin collateral, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：香港交易所开始接受合资格的人民币固定收益资产作为抵押品，以满足保证金要求。

text.en: A property unit of Zhuhai Huafa reportedly moved cash to pay a renminbi bond that was putable on Monday, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：珠海华发旗下地产公司据悉划转资金，用于支付一笔回售日为周一的人民币债券应付款项。

text.en: The PBOC's first overnight reverse repo under the new anchor was 5410 hundred million yuan (CNY541bn) at 1.25%. After 560 hundred million yuan (CNY56bn) of 7-day repos and 1 trillion yuan of overnight repos matured, the net drain was 5150 hundred million yuan (CNY515bn). China Securities Journal reported the operation.
text.zh: 中国证券报：新锚下的首次隔夜逆回购为 5410 亿元（CNY541bn），利率 1.25%。560 亿元（CNY56bn）7 天期与 1 万亿元隔夜逆回购到期后，净回笼 5150 亿元（CNY515bn）。

sources.label: 中国经济网 隔夜逆回购

text.en: RatingDog's October manufacturing PMI was 52, a 0.1 point dip from 52.1, an eleventh month of expansion, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：10 月 RatingDog 制造业 PMI 报 52，较 52.1 下降 0.1 个百分点，连续第 11 个月扩张。

text.en: If the 1% relending rate is actually drawn, Monday's equity rise has a standing policy bid behind it.
text.zh: 若 1% 的再贷款利率被真实使用，周一的股市上涨背后就有一笔长期的政策买盘。

text.en: If the chart's 2026 late-year government-bond supply, about 21000 hundred million yuan, is absorbed without higher yields, the support tools and the bond market are pulling in different directions.
text.zh: 若图表上 2026 年年底约 21000 亿元的政府债供给被吸收且收益率不升，稳市工具和债市就在朝不同方向用力。

chinaDivergences.en: RatingDog manufacturing PMI is still expanding at 52 after 52.1, while the authorities cut the buyback rate from 1.25% to 1% and opened another swap batch. The overnight reverse repo rate stayed at 1.25% on the day the relending rate was cut. A-shares rose on a day US chip shares fell.
chinaDivergences.zh: RatingDog 制造业 PMI 在 52.1 之后仍以 52 扩张，当局却把回购利率从 1.25% 降至 1%，并开启新一批互换便利。隔夜逆回购利率在再贷款利率被下调的当天仍是 1.25%。A 股在美国芯片股下跌的一天上涨。
